name: healthier
description: Healthier - Medication adherence platform for elderly care

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "INFISICAL,FRONTEND,BACKEND" --prefix-colors "yellow,cyan,magenta" "npm run dev:secrets" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.dev:secrets: infisical run --env=dev -- node -e "console.log('Secrets injected from Infisical'); setInterval(() => {}, 1000000)"
scripts.dev:frontend: cd frontend && infisical run --env=dev -- npm run dev
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && infisical run --env=dev -- uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.dev:local: concurrently --names "FRONTEND,BACKEND" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "cd frontend && npm run dev" "cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && pip install -r requirements.txt
